title: Two Hamzahs in Two Words with differing vowels
titleEn: Two Hamzahs in Two Words with differing vowels
description: When two hamzat meet across two words their vowels may match (the rules of which were covered in the previous 3 sections) or they may differ. This section covers the rules of this latter scenario. Note only Imams Nafi', Ibn Kathir and Abu 'Amr make takhfif when two hamzahs meet with differing vowels.

tashil_of_second_fatha_kasrah.title: First hamzah is maftūḥah, second maksūrah - Tashῑl of the the 2nd

examples.verse: examples of tashil of second hamzah
examples.note: The first of the two hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) and the second hamzah with a blend of the long vowel yāʾ

tashil_of_second_fatha_dhamma.title: First hamzah is maftūḥah, second maḍmūmah - Tashῑl of the the 2nd

examples.verse: examples of tashil of second hamzah
examples.note: The first of the two hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) and the second hamzah with a blend of the long vowel wāw. This example is the only instance of this scenario in the Quran.

ibdal_of_second_dhamma_fatha.title: First hamzah is maḍmūma, second maftūḥah - Ibdāl of the the 2nd

examples.verse: examples of tashil of second hamzah
examples.note: The first of the two hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) and the second hamzah with a blend of the long vowel wāw. This example is the only instance of this scenario in the Quran.

tahqiq_of_both.title: Taḥqīq of both
tahqiq_of_both.description: Both hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) with no changes made to either.
